finalText:
Wrote 4.2.0 into `CHANGELOG.md`. Out of 380 commits, only 27 touched user-visible behavior.

One feature: webhook deliveries now retry with backoff. Ten fix groups, biggest ones: null-cursor crashes on pagination across four resources, a duplicate header, and expired tokens now returning 401 not 403.

No breaking changes this time. Everything else was deps, refactors, or test churn.
